notes: The plan is UCLA Conferences & Catering's event-space diagram of the second-floor event wing (lobby, Hermosa A/B, Venice A/B, Malibu, patio): room names, no numbers, no scale. Fitted with a similarity transform on the wing's four corners from the mapped outline; the diagram is schematic, residuals up to 3.6 m.

Floor 2 is the plan's own 'Second Floor'; UCLA Space Inventory floor 2 rooms are SP2xx but have no names, so no room numbers are recorded. The site's Carnesale rooms 212A, 218 and SP206 cannot be matched to this plan.
Hermosa A/B and Venice A/B are divided by dashed lines (movable partitions); cuts follow them.
